How to create keys

  • HMAC secret: at least 32 characters.
  • AEAD key: exactly 32 bytes, stored as base64.
  • Ed25519: key pairs; requests use the client pair; responses use the server pair.
bash
composer exec securepayload keys:generate

Where to store

Env (EnvKeyProvider), database (DbKeyProvider), or a .

‼
Don't

Do not commit keys to git, send them in chat, or log secrets.

Rotation

KeyManager::rotateKey() / CLI keys:rotate support a grace period (useKeyLifecycle).

!
LocalKms

Dev only. Production: Vault/AWS/GCP/Azure.
